component.name: PhotoCropper
component.summary: Batch photo cropper and scanner image extractor

description.p: PhotoCropper automatically detects, crops, deskews, and restores multiple photos scanned together on flatbed scanners.

Features high-performance AI contour detection, automated rotation heuristics, CLAHE contrast enhancement, color balance restoration, dust inpainting, and an unattended high-throughput CLI batch processor.
